ops.prevDaySetup: Use of a banquet room, from setup to teardown, must be completed within the contracted time. Setup time and teardown time before and after the banquet are free up to a total of 1 hour; beyond 1 hour, an extension fee is charged according to the excess time. Depending on when the room is next used, an overrun may not be possible. Party use is basically 2 hours, and extensions can be discussed. (Source: Banquet Hall Terms of Use, April 2025 edition; FAQ)
ops.loadingHours: Packages for a meeting or event can be sent in advance to the hotel front desk, with the banquet name, date and room name written on them. For decorations and entertainment equipment or materials brought in by vendors other than those designated by the hotel, the hotel decides the load-in, load-out and installation times in consultation with the vendor. If hotel staff must be present, a charge for the attendant's labor applies. (Source: Banquet Hall Terms of Use, April 2025 edition)
ops.parking: The hotel has a parking lot. The fee is 700 yen for the first hour and 400 yen per 30 minutes after that. Banquet room users park free for up to 4 hours. Parking cannot be reserved and is served on a first-come basis. If the lot is full, a partner parking lot nearby is offered at the same fee. Mechanical parking [Unit 1]: height 1 m 62 cm, width 2 m 05 cm, length 5 m 75 cm; [Unit 2]: height 2 m 05 cm, width 2 m 05 cm, length 5 m 70 cm; underground parking: height 1 m 90 cm, width 1 m 95 cm, length 5 m 30 cm. Large vehicles (buses, trucks, etc.) are in principle not accepted. (Source: FAQ)
ops.waitingRooms: The 5 small banquet rooms on the Main Building 3F (Bubaria, Seseragi, Matsukaze, Hanabusa and Fujinami; 50 to 60㎡) can be used for small meetings and meals, and also as waiting rooms. (Source: Small banquet rooms page)
ops.restaurants: The hotel has 8 dining facilities: French restaurant FOURGRAINS (Main Building 1F); Japanese restaurant Hirakawa, teppanyaki Yamahiko, sushi Umihiko, bar Carousel and Chinese restaurant Nangoku Shuka (Main Building B1F); Dining Cafe Beltempo; and Patisserie Edmont. (Source: Facilities page)
